# SOUND Behavioral Health

> King County's leading nonprofit behavioral health services provider delivering comprehensive mental health, substance use, crisis, and residential care.

SOUND Behavioral Health serves King County with a full spectrum of behavioral health services grounded in diversity, equity, justice, and inclusion (DEJI) principles. The organization provides crisis intervention, mental health treatment, substance use disorder services, residential support, and family services to vulnerable populations.

## Key Topics

- Behavioral Health Services
- Crisis Support & Intervention
- Mental Health Treatment
- Substance Use Disorder Treatment
- Residential Services & Supportive Living
- Child, Youth & Family Services
- Intellectual & Developmental Disabilities (IDD)
- Diversity, Equity, Justice & Inclusion (DEJI)
- King County Community
- Nonprofit Healthcare
- Community Mental Health Act
- Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
- Recovery Services
- Organizational Mission & Vision
- Community Partnerships
